const answer: number = ((value = 1) => value)();
const dependent: number = ((left, right = left) => right)(2);
const fromPattern: number = (({ value } = { value: 3 }) => value)();
const withEarlierDefault: number = ((left = 4, right = left) => right)(...([] as const));
const fromRest: number = ((...values) => values[1])(...([4, 5] as const));
const missing: undefined = ((value) => value)();
const callback: (value: number | string) => string = (value = 6) => String(value);
console.log(answer, dependent, fromPattern, withEarlierDefault, fromRest, missing, callback("six"));
